name: CLI-Anything
description: "CLI-Anything: Making ALL Software Agent-Native" -- CLI-Hub: https://clianything.cc/
one_liner: A tool that lets any command-line program be controlled directly by AI agents, turning ordinary developer software into something an AI can operate on its own.
buyer: A developer-tools company that wants its existing CLI product to work seamlessly with AI coding agents like Claude Code or Cursor, without a custom integration for each one.
business_use_cases: A CLI-based SaaS (e.g. a deployment tool) wraps its tool with this so AI coding agents can drive deployments directly instead of needing a bespoke plugin.
An internal platform team makes 40 in-house scripts agent-callable at once, so engineers can just ask an AI agent to 'run the migration' instead of memorizing flags.
A dev-tools startup lists its product on the CLI-Hub directory to get discovered by teams building AI agent workflows.

money_ideas.idea: Offer integration consulting to make an existing CLI product 'agent-native' for dev-tool companies.
Charge dev-tool vendors a listing/placement fee on the CLI-Hub directory for visibility to agent builders.

steal_this: Pick one popular open-source CLI tool that isn't agent-friendly yet, wrap it with this over a weekend, and publish it as the first entry in a niche 'agent-ready CLI tools' directory.
